text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and repeated conclusion","quality":"positioning","description":"It states a definite argument early and keeps returning to that same position throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"“What happens if the internet fails…” and “who is at fault—the driver or the manufacturer?”","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It backs its claim with multiple explanatory points rather than just listing facts."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on internet failure, liability, and limited automation","quality":"organization","description":"It develops the argument in separate body paragraphs that each focus on a different concern."},{"evidence":"“As the text states” and quoted evidence","quality":"textual use","description":"It explicitly pulls in details from the source article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"“They need help with certain situations…” followed by “how will it manage to drive on expressways…”","quality":"logical extension","description":"It draws an inference from the article’s information to question whether the cars can really function safely on their own."}]}
